_note: Story simulation scheduler: tick_hz = fixed gameplay updates per second; max_steps_per_frame = maximum catch-up updates before drawing the next frame; max_pending_steps = the most ticks of time that may wait, more is dropped (0 = keep all, the world never slows). With 2 and 3 a slow frame cannot pile up catch-up work (no spiral): below 30 FPS the world runs slower instead of stuttering. Pause and floor loads explicitly reset the clock. Rendering has no FPS cap from this file. Details: docs/FESTER-SIMULATIONSTAKT.de.md.
